summary: Client TCP reset / request timeout during very large prompt + max_tokens; KV serialization stall observed
description:
Issue summary:
Customer ScaleDocs reports repeated client connection resets and 499/504-like timeouts when sending requests with very large prompt prefixes (~180k tokens) combined with high max_tokens (>=120k). Problem started 2026-03-11 after a traffic spike. Customer uses a Dedicated pool pinned to redwood-v1-30b-quant.

Impact:
- A subset (~3%) of long-context generation requests from ScaleDocs are failing to stream final chunks; downstream application treats this as a hard failure.
- Observed 499 (client closed) and backend proxy 504s. Customer reports user-facing errors and partial transcripts missing last 10-30% of output.

Environment:
- Dedicated capacity (prod - us-west), tenant ScaleDocs Inc., pinned model redwood-v1-30b-quant, runtime version v1.2.3, autoscaling disabled for this pool.
- Example request: prompt size ~180k tokens, max_tokens=128000, streaming=true, temperature=0.2.

Steps to reproduce (reported by customer and confirmed on repro cluster):
1) POST /v1/generate with a large prefix (~150k-200k tokens) and max_tokens >= 100k.
2) Start streaming; initial chunks return normally.
3) After 60-120s into generation the client connection resets (seen as FIN from client) or upstream proxy returns 504.
4) Server logs show servicing thread blocked in kv-cache serialization/finalizer for very long periods before the process sends the final bytes.

Relevant logs / traces:
- Example trace id: trace-20260311-7c2f. Serving runtime logs: "kv_cache: serialize took 128.3s (size=1.9GB) - blocking finalizer".
- Proxy logs: "upstream timeout (110s) while reading response headers from upstream".
- Nginx/proxy recorded client FIN prior to complete response in 18% of repro runs.
- No GPU OOMs or CUDA errors in corresponding node logs. Memory pressure (RSS) on runtime process increases during finalization spike.

Notes: customer is on Dedicated with constrained instance type (A100-40GB). Long prefix leads to very large KV structures which appear to trigger a pathological serialization path in the runtime finalizer that runs synchronously and blocks the response stream for tens of seconds.
comments: 2026-03-12 15:45 - Support (Aisha Patel): Triage complete. Escalating to Serving runtime eng. Customer provided 3 failing request IDs and a sample (sanitized) prompt. Asked for ETA on mitigation.

2026-03-12 16:05 - SRE (Marco Chen): Reproduced on internal repro cluster using same model + input shape. Observed long blocking in kv-serialization code path. Created flamegraph; GC not the primary blocker. Assigning to runtime team. Attaching trace-20260311-7c2f.
2026-03-12 17:30 - Customer (Olivia Nguyen, ScaleDocs): We can temporarily reduce max_tokens but it would impact batch jobs. Would appreciate a short-term config we can set on our dedicated pool.

2026-03-12 19:10 - Eng (Priya Rao): Hypothesis: synchronous write/serialization of in-memory KV to temp buffer + single-threaded finalizer causes head-of-line blocking. Proposing config guardrails: reject requests above configurable KV-serialization token threshold and make finalizer streaming-friendly. Preparing patch proposal.

2026-03-13 09:05 - Support (Aisha Patel): Temporary mitigation applied for ScaleDocs: pool-level setting max_effective_max_tokens=65536 enforced; customer confirmed reduction in failures during evening window. Customer asked for timeline for permanent fix.
investigation_notes: Flamegraph shows finalizer spends >90% time in memcpy/serialize when kv size >1.2GB.
No evidence of GPU saturation. CPU threads starved due to blocking syscalls in finalizer.
Proxy timeouts align with serialization wall time (110-130s) in reproducible runs.
Reproduced on separate dedicated node type (V100-32GB) with same behavior; suggests codepath not hardware-specific.
Quick patch (non-production) increased serialization concurrency via worker threads and reduced block time to ~8-12s in repro. Needs careful review for memory/regression risk.
Related to past investigation: INT-4122 flagged large-KV eviction regressions after v1.2.0 change to single-thread finalizer.
Customer traces include request IDs: req-84221, req-84222, req-84223 for our reference.
resolution:
Mitigation: Applied pool-level temporary limit on effective max_tokens to 65536 for ScaleDocs dedicated pool (config change rolled out 2026-03-12 18:50 UTC). This reduced occurrence rate from ~3% to <0.1% during monitor window.

Planned fix: Runtime patch to make KV finalization non-blocking (parallel serialization workers + backpressure / request rejection when kv_size > threshold). Patch PR linked: https://github.com/redwood-inference/runtime/pull/4123. Target release v1.2.5 (canary 2026-03-17, full rollout 2026-03-20) pending security signoff.

Workarounds provided to customer: reduce max_tokens, enable prefix trimming, or move heavy long-context workloads to a dedicated high-memory pool (48GB+). Follow-up: add server-side soft-reject with clear error (413 Payload Too Large style) for requests with estimated serialization cost > configured threshold.
